text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a node in us-west-2 where GPU0 fan tach toggles between ~1400 rpm and 0 rpm. Power draw also drops from ~250W to ~60W intermittently. Several inference routes showing 95th+ latency spikes and transient 504s.

raj: Which node? any Xid/ECC in logs?

maria: node gpu-node-03b, pool=dedicated-usw2-g4. quick nvidia-smi snapshot and dmesg below.

maria: ```
NVIDIA-SMI 530.41.03    Driver Version: 530.41.03    CUDA Version: 12.0
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
|  0   A100-PCIE-80GB     Off   | 00000000:3D:00.0 Off |                    0 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 0  GeForce RTX...  P0   250W / 300W
| Fan: 1400 RPM -> suddenly 0 RPM (reported)
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
dmesg tail: 
[12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3d:00): 61, GPU has fallen off the bus
[12345.679002] kernel: nvidia 0000:3d:00.0: GPU watchdog: timeout
[12345.679100] gpu-drain: starting node drain for gpu-node-03b
```

jess: Xid 61 is usually hardware or PCIe link flakiness. Could be riser or power delivery. But fan tach=0 looks like sensor glitch too. Did SMM logs capture a thermal trip?

oncall-ryan: I just saw autoscaler start killing pods on that node, which caused a small surge on surrounding nodes. Autoscaler log: 

oncall-ryan: ```
ScalingEvent: node gpu-node-03b unresponsive -> cordon/evict triggered
ScheduleDelay: increased by 200ms on routes: /gen, /chat
```

raj: Can we repro hardware readings locally? pinged BMC yet?

maria: pinged BMC, IPMI responded but sensor readouts intermittent. BMC shows fan_tach0 alternating between valid RPM and 0. PSU current draw matches GPU power drops.

sre-bot: Runbook hint: if fan tach oscillates with Xid 61, isolate node and schedule replacement. Suggested commands: `kubectl cordon/evict` + tag node as `needs-rma`.

maria: Did a soft drain earlier: `kubectl drain gpu-node-03b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — eviction succeeded, took ~45s for large batches.

jess: For short term, we can flip the node to a diagnostic pool and reduce workload to run continuous stress for 30m while we watch NVML stats. If it reproduces, open vendor RMA.

raj: Also check if a recent kernel/driver bump landed on that node. Driver was updated last week in that rack image; rolling back could be informative but risky mid-peak.

maria: Driver version matches fleet baseline (530.41.03). No recent kernel changes on that host.

deploy-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-042 - gpu-node-03b intermittent PCIe/fan sensor causing inference latency.

jess: Quick mitigation: add affinity to avoid scheduling latency-critical routes onto dedicated-usw2-g4 pool for next 2 hours. Update rollout in console -> routes -> /chat,/gen set lower weight.

oncall-ryan: Done. Traffic shifted to dedicated-useast-1 and dedicated-eu-west with minimal error increase. 95th latency dropped back to normal after shift.

raj: For postmortem: we should improve alerting to correlate GPU sensor flaps (fan_tach=0) with NVML Xid events and increase severity when autoscaler reacts. Also add an automated node-tagging step `needs-diagnostics` so infra sees it in pager flow.

maria: Agreed. I'll file a runbook PR: add a check in fleet-monitor that raises S1 if (fan_tach==0 for >2 samples AND Xid in [61,32,16]) OR if power draw delta >150W within 1s.

jess: Also propose a quick script to perform a soft nvml reset and re-run diagnostics before RMA so vendor has richer logs: `python tools/gpu_diag/reset_and_capture.py --duration 600`. Runs only in maintenance window.

raj: One more datapoint — telemetry shows this node had a higher-than-average thermal cycling count over last 90 days. Might be end-of-life behavior.

maria: Action items: 1) node cordoned and evicted (done), 2) moved traffic away (done), 3) scheduled diagnostic run and vendor ticket, 4) PR for alerting + tagging. I'll follow up with vendor RMA if diag reproduces.

sre-bot: Follow-up checklist added to INC-2026-042.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post updates here after diagnostics finish (~30–90m). :white_check_mark:
